cases.prompt: Review a TMol CUDA scoring optimization against origin/master. Confirm correctness and flexibility, measure latency, peak memory, and physical launches on representative B1 and B32 inputs, and prepare only the production change and focused regression tests for review.

setup.cwd: clean TMol worktree on the candidate branch

expected_behavior: Uses isolated build/JIT caches for baseline and candidate
Synchronizes CUDA timing and uses matched representative inputs
Tests decomposed and unweighted scores, custom or zero weights, and gradients when affected
Reports latency, peak allocated memory, launch counts, and correctness together
Keeps raw profiles, plots, and one-off benchmark harnesses outside the production diff
Runs focused, subsystem, and code-quality gates before recommending merge

cases.prompt: Add a public helper to tmol.pose that returns the side-chain torsion values of selected blocks, taking the pose stack, the device and a parameter database.

setup.cwd: TMol source checkout with development dependencies

expected_behavior: Reads docs/style_guide.md before naming the function and its parameters
Uses spelled-out names such as pose_stack, param_db, device and sidechain rather than ps, mc/sc or torch_device
Lists param_db before device in the signature
Runs python scripts/check_api_style.py and fixes any new violation instead of adding it to scripts/api_style_baseline.txt
